description: A mint press on a low plinth at the end of the counter, kept under a dust cover between customers, with a strip of carpet in front of it worn down to the weave. This is the good one. The civic presses were decommissioned and this is where they went, one at a time, bought at auction and rebuilt on a bench in the back room by a man who has strong opinions about registration error. A brass plate on the housing has been engraved, by hand, and reads: IT IS A RECORD OF YOU. STAND UP STRAIGHT.
name: the Mint Condition press
